tool.about: Discover accelerator Programs and compare them with your company profile. Saved fit results are shared with colleagues who have full document access. Review current details on each Program's official website.

common.readOnly: You can read saved fit results, but your role cannot run matching.
common.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
common.accessBody: Accelerators is available only to active company members with access to all company documents and the required document permissions. Ask a company administrator to review your access.

home.title: Find your accelerator
home.description: Compare accelerators with your company profile, learn from similar companies that got in, and track where you apply.
home.matchHint: Matching compares {count, plural, one {# Program} other {# Programs}} with the current company profile; the rest of the list is not matched yet. A fit score is not a probability of acceptance.
home.profileMissing: Build the company profile in Settings → Company before matching Programs.
home.emptyBody: A trusted installation operator must import reviewed Program records. There are no sample or automatically generated results here.

discovery.noResultsBody: Try different search terms or reset the filters to see all imported Programs.

fit.title: Your fit
fit.disclaimer: A fit score is not a probability of acceptance.
fit.staleBecause: Out of date: {reasons}. Click Match Programs to update it; no rematch happens automatically.
fit.unmatchedHint: No saved fit assessment. Matching starts only when you choose Match Programs.

program.noCycles: No Cycle information has been confirmed.
program.portalNote: Confirm current dates and requirements on the Program's official website or application portal.

run.pollFailed: Could not refresh matching progress. The run may still be in progress.

similar.unsupported: Similar companies need the accelerator's past batches. In this demo, only Y Combinator has them.
similar.intro: Out of {total, number} publicly listed YC companies from past batches, ordered by how closely what they do matches your profile. Each shows how it pitches itself in YC's directory, and the application it got in with when the founders or YC published it.
similar.profileMissing: Build the company profile in Settings → Company to see similar companies.

provenance.original: Published by the founders or YC

similar.referenceOnly: {count} answers, shown as published. For reference only.
similar.unsupportedTitle: Not available for this accelerator yet

dimensions.insufficientHint: Evidence covers {coverage}% of the applicable weight; an overall score needs at least {minimum}%.

details.dealHint: Fixed equity only. Uncapped SAFEs and conditional amounts add dilution that depends on later rounds; read the full terms below.

vision.sectorsHint: Shows Programs that name any selected sector. Programs open to any sector are included.
vision.includeIneligible: Include Programs you are not eligible for
vision.aiMatchHint: These use the saved AI match from Match Programs.

tracker.title: Applications
tracker.notTracked: Track this accelerator to set a priority, plan tasks and record where your application stands.
tracker.notesPlaceholder: Only your company can see these notes.
tracker.untrackBody: This deletes the status, notes and tasks for this cycle. Your application on the Program's site is not affected.
tracker.openTasks: {count, plural, =0 {No open tasks} one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
tracker.emptyBody: Track an accelerator from its page to plan tasks and record where your application stands.
tracker.summary: {tracked, plural, one {# application} other {# applications}} · {pending, number} awaiting a decision

errors.runInProgress: A company run is already starting or running. Wait for it to finish before matching Programs.
errors.fullAccess: Accelerators requires access to all company documents.
errors.profileRequired: Build the company profile before matching Programs.
errors.notFound: This Program or matching run was not found.
errors.conflict: The saved data changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.invalid: The matching request is not valid.
errors.credits: There are not enough credits for matching.
